info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Market Order Management API
info.description: The Market Order Management API enables users to seamlessly place and manage market orders within the wholesale trading environment. Designed for financial institutions and traders, this API provides the essential functionality to initiate market order transactions, ensuring efficient execution of trades. Typical consumers include brokerage firms and asset managers looking to optimize their trading strategies. With robust support for various order types and real-time processing, this API facilitates a streamlined trading experience.

post.summary: Create a market order in wholesale trading.
post.description: This endpoint allows users to create a market order for wholesale trading. Users must provide the necessary details in the request body to successfully execute the order in the market.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to place a market order in the wholesale trading system. It should contain all necessary details about the order such as quantity, product ID, and transaction type to ensure that the order is processed correctly.

201.description: Resource created successfully, indicating the market order has been successfully processed.
